Remember that $y=|x-h|+k$ is a translation of the absolute value graph $y=|x|$ by $h$ units right and $k$ units up.

The function $y=|x+1|+2$ has $h=-1$ and $k=2.$ Therefore, it is a translation of the absolute value graph $y=|x|$ by $1$ unit *left* and $2$ units up.
